title: Tolerable Inflation, Intolerable Uncertainty
abstract: arXiv:2609.31512v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Numerical inflation targets anchor beliefs. Across euro-area and US professional forecasts, inflation swaps and options, and realized inflation, uncertainty about inflation is compressed at the announced number and kinks exactly there. This paper identifies a cost of the same design that, to our knowledge, has not been shown before, and that appears in second moments only. Within the workhorse New Keynesian model, tolerating part of the inflation a supply shock produces is optimal, yet the optimal tolerated share is not identified: optimal look-through and an unwarranted drift of the effective target are observationally equivalent in the inflation history, so a central bank cannot demonstrate that a warranted deviation is warranted, ex post as much as in real time. Agents holding finite, heterogeneous patience then generate predictive variance that is flat below the target and rises linearly with the expected overshoot above it -- an obs

translated_title: 可容忍的通胀，不可容忍的不确定性
translated_abstract: 数值型通胀目标锚定了人们的信念。在欧元区和美国的专业预测、通胀互换与期权数据以及实际实现的通胀中，通胀的不确定性恰好在公布的目标数字处被压缩，并且折点也正好出现在那里。本文识别出这种设计的另一种成本——据我们所知，此前从未被揭示过——且该成本仅体现在二阶矩之中。在新凯恩斯主义标准工作模型中，容忍供给冲击所产生的一部分通胀是最优的，但最优容忍份额却无法被识别：最优的“看穿”（look-through）策略与有效目标的缺乏依据的漂移，在通胀历史数据中是观测等价的，因此无论事后还是在实时决策中，央行都无法证明一次有正当理由的偏离确实是有正当理由的。当经济主体拥有有限且异质的耐心时，由此产生的预测方差在目标以下保持平坦，而在目标以上则随预期超调幅度线性上升——这是一……
tldr: 本文首次揭示了数值通胀目标的一个仅体现在二阶矩上的成本：由于央行无法证明对目标偏离的正当性，拥有有限且异质耐心的经济主体会使通胀预测方差在目标以下保持平坦、在目标以上随预期超调线性上升，从而带来不可容忍的不确定性。
en_tdlr: This paper identifies a previously unshown cost of numerical inflation targets that appears only in second moments: because the central bank cannot demonstrate that deviations from the target are warranted, agents with finite and heterogeneous patience generate predictive variance that is flat below the target and rises linearly with the expected overshoot above it.
